about.label: About
about.title: Understanding both worlds.
about.quote: I align security with reality: governance, compliance, and operational defense.
about.p1: A cybersecurity engineer in the making, I currently work as a security project lead (apprenticeship) at DOMPLUS Groupe in Grenoble. My ground: governance, risk and compliance — ISSP, GDPR, security committees, third-party risk — and their very concrete translation into infrastructure and tooling.
about.p2: Before security, I was a lead developer: Sage X3 ERP, Laravel and Node.js applications, a ticketing platform built from scratch. That past gives me a rare angle — I know what a developer can break, and how a system is governed.
about.p3: Next heading: a Master’s degree in IT Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Management, with a thesis already underway on deploying Sekoia XDR.
